model_annotation:
This figure consists of two side-by-side line charts that examine the effect of two different hyperparameters on BLEU score. Both charts share the same y-axis configuration: the y-axis is labeled "BLEU," scaled linearly from 28.0 to 28.5, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1.

The left chart shows BLEU as a function of the hyperparameter α. The x-axis is labeled "α" with linearly spaced tick marks at 0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, and 0.9. A single blue line with circular markers connects the data points. The line begins at approximately 27.99 at α = 0.1, rises to about 28.32 at α = 0.3, reaches a peak of approximately 28.53 at α = 0.5, then decreases to roughly 28.40 at α = 0.7, and drops further to about 28.12 at α = 0.9.

The right chart shows BLEU as a function of the hyperparameter p. The x-axis is labeled "p" with linearly spaced tick marks at 0.05, 0.15, 0.25, 0.35, and 0.45. A single blue line with circular markers connects the data points. The line starts at approximately 28.31 at p = 0.05, rises to a peak of approximately 28.53 at p = 0.15, then decreases to about 28.42 at p = 0.25, increases slightly to roughly 28.47 at p = 0.35, and settles at approximately 28.43 at p = 0.45.
